rationale: SkiaCanvas::begin_layer compiles its Ganesh offscreen-surface call only when SK_GANESH is defined (the WebGL browser host), matching the guard the image-upload and backend-identity paths already use. Native builds never set the Ganesh context, so their Graphite and raster layer paths are unchanged and output is identical; the link stops keeping Skia's Ganesh backend. No design-import, Chromium, rendering or packaging authority moves.
